resources.string: Read the device proximity sensor and its near/far indication.
This device has no proximity sensor.

Waiting for a valid proximity reading…
Near/far unknown: no valid hardware maximum range.

Many proximity sensors report only two states, not precise distance. Near means the value is below the hardware maximum; far means at or above it. Device behavior varies. This is not a precision rangefinder, health assessment, or device certification.
Only the foreground sensor is used. Readings clear on leaving; no permissions, network, history, saved results, or sharing.
Open the tool and move an object toward and away from the device proximity sensor without pressing on the screen.
An uncovered sensor may report its maximum value as far; covering it may report a lower value as near.
Often binary and hardware-dependent. Reported centimetres do not guarantee precise distance. Unknown maximum means no near/far classification.
